description: 🆕 Commerce Payments flows are DRIVEN by an operator — it authorizes escrow, captures for merchants and takes the fees. This audits one before you rely on it: 90-day volumes, fees taken, capture-vs-reclaim record (missed capture windows = merchants left unpaid), distinct payers and merchants. verdict: healthy_operator / mixed / sloppy_operator / no_activity. No other tool reads this new Base commerce protocol.
